sahelanthropus-tchadensis.research_focus: current reconstructions of Sahelanthropus tchadensis and the wooded lakeside landscape of the Djurab Desert region of Chad about 7 million years ago
sahelanthropus-tchadensis.scene: A small-brained, ape-like creature stands at the edge of a lakeside woodland, its head set squarely on an upright neck; an ape, not a modern human

orrorin-tugenensis.research_focus: current reconstructions of Orrorin tugenensis and the Tugen Hills woodland of Kenya about 6 million years ago
orrorin-tugenensis.scene: A chimpanzee-sized hominin steps upright along a thick tree branch in an evergreen forest, one hand steadying itself on the bough above

ardipithecus-ramidus-appears.research_focus: current reconstructions of Ardipithecus ramidus (Ardi), with its grasping, opposable big toe, and the Middle Awash woodland of Ethiopia
ardipithecus-ramidus-appears.scene: A long-armed hominin walks upright across a woodland floor, its splayed big toe clearly gripping-shaped, fig trees overhead

australopithecus-anamensis-appears.research_focus: current reconstructions of Australopithecus anamensis and the gallery forest around ancient Lake Turkana, Kenya
australopithecus-anamensis-appears.scene: An upright-walking australopith with a projecting jaw wades along a lakeshore fringed with gallery forest, scanning the water

laetoli-footprints.research_focus: the Laetoli footprint trail in Tanzania, its two parallel tracks in damp volcanic ash, and the Sadiman volcano
laetoli-footprints.scene: Two small upright figures seen from behind walk side by side across a plain of fresh grey ash, a line of footprints trailing behind them and a smoking volcano in the distance

australopithecus-africanus-appears.research_focus: current reconstructions of Australopithecus africanus, the Taung Child and Sterkfontein, and the mosaic woodland-grassland of South Africa
australopithecus-africanus-appears.scene: A slender, small-brained hominin family forages among rocky outcrops and acacia scrub, a juvenile clinging to an adult's side

oldowan-stone-tools.research_focus: Oldowan stone toolmaking at Gona and Olduvai: hammerstones, river cobbles, sharp flakes and butchered bones
oldowan-stone-tools.scene: Close on two hairy hands striking a river cobble with a hammerstone, sharp flakes scattered on the ground beside an animal bone

paranthropus-boisei-appears.research_focus: current reconstructions of Paranthropus boisei (Nutcracker Man), its sagittal crest and huge molars, and East African wetland grasses and sedges
paranthropus-boisei-appears.scene: A heavy-jawed hominin with a bony crest along the top of its skull chews a fistful of tough sedge stems at the edge of a marsh

homo-erectus-stands-tall.research_focus: current reconstructions of Homo erectus, with modern body proportions, long legs and a low, heavy-browed skull, on the open East African savanna
homo-erectus-stands-tall.scene: A tall, long-legged early human with a heavy brow ridge strides across open savanna carrying a stone handaxe, the horizon wide behind

dmanisi-humans-leave-africa.research_focus: the Dmanisi hominins of Georgia and their landscape about 1.8 million years ago: a promontory above river valleys with mixed forest and steppe
dmanisi-humans-leave-africa.scene: A small band of short, small-brained early humans picks its way over a rocky promontory above two converging river valleys, hills rolling into the distance

homo-antecessor-atapuerca.research_focus: Homo antecessor at Gran Dolina, Sierra de Atapuerca, Spain, and its early Pleistocene landscape
homo-antecessor-atapuerca.scene: Early humans crouch at the mouth of a limestone cave in a wooded hillside, cutting meat from a carcass with simple stone flakes

wonderwerk-cave-fire.research_focus: evidence of early controlled fire deep inside Wonderwerk Cave, Northern Cape, South Africa, and its long tunnel-like interior
wonderwerk-cave-fire.scene: Deep inside a long cave, a small fire of burning brush and bone lights the faces of crouching early humans, the cave mouth a distant bright opening behind them

neanderthals-emerge-europe.research_focus: current reconstructions of early Neanderthals and the Sima de los Huesos population, and a cold Middle Pleistocene European landscape
neanderthals-emerge-europe.scene: A stocky, broad-chested Neanderthal in a fur wrap stands on a frosty hillside above a river valley, a wooden spear in hand

homo-naledi-appears.research_focus: current reconstructions of Homo naledi, with curved fingers and a small brain, and the dark, narrow chambers of the Rising Star cave system in South Africa
homo-naledi-appears.scene: A slight, small-headed human with curved fingers squeezes through a narrow limestone passage, lit dimly from somewhere behind

jebel-irhoud-homo-sapiens.research_focus: the early Homo sapiens of Jebel Irhoud, Morocco, with a modern face and an elongated braincase, and the Middle Stone Age landscape of North Africa
jebel-irhoud-homo-sapiens.scene: Early modern humans with flat faces and long skulls sit around a hearth below a rocky outcrop, knapping pointed stone tools; a grassland stretches beyond

misliya-cave-sapiens.research_focus: Misliya Cave on Mount Carmel, Israel, its rock-shelter setting and the Levantine Middle Palaeolithic landscape
misliya-cave-sapiens.scene: Modern humans sit in a wide rock shelter on a limestone hillside overlooking the coastal plain and the sea, a fire burning at its mouth

denisovans-emerge.research_focus: current reconstructions of Denisovans, the Denisova Cave in the Altai and the high-altitude Baishiya Karst Cave on the Tibetan Plateau
denisovans-emerge.scene: A robust, heavy-browed archaic human in skins stands at the mouth of a high mountain cave, snowy peaks and a cold plateau behind

last-homo-erectus-java.research_focus: the last Homo erectus population at Ngandong on the Solo River, Java, and its open woodland and river landscape
last-homo-erectus-java.scene: A lone, heavy-browed early human stands on a riverbank in a Javan woodland at dusk, looking out over a wide brown river; a quiet ending, not a death scene

homo-floresiensis-hobbit.research_focus: current reconstructions of Homo floresiensis, Liang Bua cave on Flores, and the island's dwarf Stegodon elephants and Komodo dragons
homo-floresiensis-hobbit.scene: A metre-tall human with a small head and long feet stalks a dwarf elephant through island forest, a stone tool in one hand; human-sized proportions, not a fantasy hobbit

homo-luzonensis-appears.research_focus: Homo luzonensis, its curved finger and toe bones, Callao Cave in northern Luzon, Philippines, and its tropical forest setting
homo-luzonensis-appears.scene: A small human with curved fingers and toes climbs a tree trunk at the edge of tropical forest outside a large limestone cave

sapiens-neanderthal-interbreeding.research_focus: contact between modern humans and Neanderthals in western Eurasia about 50,000 years ago, and current reconstructions of both
sapiens-neanderthal-interbreeding.scene: A tall, slender modern human and a stocky, heavy-browed Neanderthal sit side by side at one campfire, a small child between them

last-neanderthals-vanish.research_focus: the last Neanderthals of southern Iberia, Gorham's Cave in Gibraltar, and the Late Pleistocene coastal landscape
last-neanderthals-vanish.scene: A small Neanderthal group sits at the mouth of a great sea cave above a wide coastal plain, looking out at the sea in fading evening light; a quiet ending, not a death scene
